sentence: Tidy up the backyard, it just needs a light clean.

evidence.note: A wooden plank gate is visible in the fence line to the right of the shed; its width can't be judged from this angle, so a narrow side gate is possible but not confirmed.

observation.model_notes: The two photos appear to show two visually distinct properties (Photo 1: a North American-style yard with a wood-frame shed, an above-ground pool built into a deck, chain-link fencing, and neighboring clapboard houses; Photo 2: a different-looking property with a brick outbuilding, paved patio, gravel strip, and wooden board fencing, with brick buildings behind). A scope should confirm both photos are from the same job/address before finalizing, since I cannot verify that from the images alone.

evidence.note: Lawn shows mower-stripe pattern with some patchy, drier/thinner patches; no large debris, downed branches, or heavy overgrowth visible.
Scattered dry leaves and small twigs cover the paved patio and gravel strip, and a few weeds are growing in the gravel and along the shed wall base; overall clutter is minor.
